feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 May 2026 10:34pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 15 May 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Weak ridge of high pressure is gradually displaced from the west as a weather front arrives tomorrow.


##Wind##

Northwest 3 or 4, gradually backing West or Northwest 2 to 4 overnight, then backing South or Southwest 3 or 4 during morning or early afternoon. Then veering and increasing West 4 or 5 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow evening.


##Weather##

Fair, then outbreaks of rain and drizzle spreading from the west tomorrow, clearing later in evening.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4 or 5 tomorrow night, occasionally 6 in a few places. Backing Southwest 4 or 5 on Sunday morning, decreasing 3 or 4 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers later.
